title: Genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screen reveals factors that influence the susceptibility of tumor cells to NK cell-mediated killing
model: HCT-116-Cas9, Brunello KO library, KHYG-1 NK-cell co-culture
contrast: Survivors of KHYG-1 co-culture, round 1 vs mutant collection (1 vs 1)
paper_calls: 119 NKp44-dependent hits at FDR 0.5; ICAM1, apoptosis and IFN-gamma genes highlighted
barcs_calls: 265 genes at FDR 0.10 (9 enriched), screening-level; round 2: 178 (49 enriched)
named_hits: Apoptosis/IFN-gamma: 4/10 at FDR 0.10 in round 1 (CASP8, FADD, FAF1, IFNGR1), 10/10 in round 2; ICAM1 not recovered
verdict: BARCS recovers the apoptosis (CASP8, FADD, BID, FAS, FAF1) and IFN-gamma (IFNGR1/2, JAK1/2, STAT1) resistance genes, strongly after two rounds, but finds no enrichment of the headline NKp44-synapse gene ICAM1.
